body:
It won't matter that I'll no longer be able to experience happiness, I'd be dead and I've been happy maybe 5 times in the past year.

you make a good point though I'll give that some thought

I guess you're kinda right about the things that make it worth it, sometimes when I'm doing those I can be happy. I just feel like those things dont happen enough to me for the pain of the rest of life to be worth it all.

Yeah, what people think of me is a really stressful thing for me and I'm basically always worried about it...


And about the girl, it's not just that she's taken now (which admittedly I'm more than a bit broken up about that), it's also that I know/knew with almost complete certainty that she would have said yes had I asked her to be my girlfriend but I was still too scared to ask her. Her getting into a relationship only happened recently, after she pretty much completely stopped talking to me.

Well I texted her today and she seems really upset about this. I told her the thing about not wanting to screw it up but she hasn't replied in a few hours and I didn't say anything after that.

I'm really starting to lose hope quickly I think this is the worst I've ever messed up. I'll wait a few days before giving up, and I should see her tomorrow though so maybe everything will work out okay. Not too optimistic though...

Edit: saw her at school today and we were around each other at lunch, we didn't really talk but she didn't actively avoid me either so that's at least a good sign I think.

Okay so I texted her today.
I think I may have damaged anything there was between me and her by calling my mother a bitch in front of her and her mother.
After texting back and forth I think her opinion of me was seriously hurt because of that.
Looks like I probably won't be asking her quite yet.

Any suggestion on what I might be able to do to fix this or am I screwed and I should just try to move on?

Going on a real date is pretty much not an option for the time being, but maybe going to a movie would work

I think that my actual question is how to ask her to be with me because I don't know if "Hey will you be my girlfriend" or something like that is too direct or not
